description: Land Acquisition - Olaithoduwaikani, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple declarations under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purposes. It provides detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, locations, and claimants, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the primary land acquisition content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger Types 1-3.
